name: Armies Of Israel The
overview: The armies of Israel were divinely empowered and directed, as reflected in Exodus 15 where the LORD is declared a man of war who triumphs gloriously over His enemies. Their strength and victory were attributed not to human might alone but to God's powerful hand, which dashed the enemy and secured deliverance. This underscores the spiritual reality that Israel’s military success depended on God’s presence and guidance, affirming the necessity of consulting and relying on Him in battle.
